# Copilot Instructions

## Project

Movie Recommendation App built with React, Express, MongoDB and TMDB.

## Coding Style

- Use ES6+ JavaScript.
- Use async/await instead of promise chains.
- Use functional React components and hooks.
- Keep functions small and reusable.
- Avoid duplicate code.

## Backend

- Keep controllers thin.
- Move business logic into services when appropriate.
- Return consistent JSON responses.
- Handle errors using try/catch.

## Frontend

- Reuse existing components.
- Keep UI responsive.
- Follow the existing folder structure.

## General Rules

- Explain changes before editing files.
- Do not remove existing features unless requested.
- Preserve existing API routes.
- Write beginner-friendly code.
